item: D1 friend declarations added in two families
spelling: class CShaderRenderManager { ... friend class CShaderResource; }; class CInputProcessManager { ... friend class CAInputProcess; };
evidence: Ego_r.pdb / FableWin.pdb give the callees private or protected access: ?CreatePixelShader@CShaderRenderManager@@AAE.. and ?RemoveInputProcess@CInputProcessManager@@IAEXAAVCAInputProcess@@@Z. Their retail callers are members of CShaderResource (0x00A5D620) and CAInputProcess (the ??_G at 0x00A0D410), so the code only compiles with a friend, as with the D4 precedent (CShaderRenderManager in CPixelShader). The PDB friend records are not available on the Linux lane, so they were not checked directly. Both rows recheck RELOCATION_MATCH + PASS.
decision needed: Ratify the two friend lines on the row-local class models (the code is the only evidence for them), or hold the rows until the PDB LF_FRIENDCLS records are checked on Windows.

Under the contract, the includer defines the polymorphic CDataOutputStream (: CDataStream : CBaseClassNonCopyable) before including the header.
